title: 2017-18 Panini Prizm Mosaic Red #33 Kent Bazemore Atlanta Hawks Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2017-18 Panini Prizm Mosaic trading card featuring Kent Bazemore of the Atlanta Hawks in a Red parallel variety. The card is part of the Donruss Optic series within the National Basketball Association (NBA). It is an original card manufactured by Panini in the United States in 2018 for the 2017-18 season. The card number is #33 and it is not autographed.
